class CaseWrite {
  value;
  constructor(candidate: number) {
    switch (candidate) {
      case (this.value = 1): break;
      default: break;
    }
  }
}
class MultipleCases {
  value;
  constructor(candidate: string) {
    switch (candidate) {
      case (this.value = "one"): break;
      case (this.value = "two"): break;
    }
  }
}
class Discriminant {
  value;
  constructor(candidate: number) {
    switch (this.value = candidate) {
      case 1: break;
      default: break;
    }
  }
}
console.log(new CaseWrite(1).value, new MultipleCases("one").value, new Discriminant(2).value.toFixed());
